```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)

## Platania data (gendered counts)
platania <- tibble::tribble(
  ~gender,  ~subtype, ~n,
  "Male",   "ADHD-I", 289,
  "Male",   "ADHD-HI", 12,
  "Male",   "ADHD-C", 525,
  "Male", "other_specifed", 1,
  "Male", "unspecified", 2,
  "Female", "ADHD-I", 420,
  "Female", "ADHD-HI", 32,
  "Female", "ADHD-C", 832,
  "Female", "other_specifed", 10,
    "Female", "unspecified", 6
)

## total sample == 2129 (for subtypes)


## Psykiatrien overall distribution (proportions)
psykiatrien <- tibble::tribble(
  ~source,        ~subtype, ~prop,
  "Psykiatrien",  "ADHD-I", 0.10,
  "Psykiatrien",  "ADHD-HI", 0.05,
    "Psykiatrien",  "ADHD-C", 0.85
)
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)

valid_subtypes <- c("ADHD-I", "ADHD-HI", "ADHD-C")

platania_clean <- platania %>%
  filter(subtype %in% valid_subtypes)

# 1) Build gender-within-subtype data ----
gender_within_subtype <- platania_clean %>%
  group_by(subtype, gender) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(subtype) %>%
  mutate(
    pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 2)   # % within each subtype
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # enforce desired row order: ADHD-I, ADHD-HI, ADHD-C
  mutate(
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = c("ADHD-I", "ADHD-HI", "ADHD-C"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(subtype) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = gender,              # Male / Female
    values_from = c(n, pct),
    names_sep   = "_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total   = n_Male + n_Female,
    subtype = as.character(subtype)    # back to character for nicer printing
  )

# 2) Add "Total" row ----
gender_within_total <- gender_within_subtype %>%
  bind_rows(
    gender_within_subtype %>%
      summarise(
        subtype    = "Total",
        n_Male     = sum(n_Male,    na.rm = TRUE),
        n_Female   = sum(n_Female,  na.rm = TRUE),
        pct_Male   = round(n_Male   / (n_Male + n_Female) * 100, 2),
        pct_Female = round(n_Female / (n_Male + n_Female) * 100, 2),
        total      = sum(total,      na.rm = TRUE)
      )
  )

# 3) Create styled gt table ----
gt_gender_table2 <- gender_within_total %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Gender Distributions Within Subtypes",
    subtitle = "Following data cleaning (n = 2,110)"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    subtype    = "Subtype",
    n_Male     = "Males (n)",
    pct_Male   = "Males (%)",
    n_Female   = "Females (n)",
    pct_Female = "Females (%)",
    total      = "Total (n)"
  ) %>%
  # make table a bit wider / airier
  tab_options(
    table.width          = pct(60),
    data_row.padding     = px(20),
    column_labels.padding = px(8)
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = everything()
  ) %>%
  # numeric formatting
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(n_Male, n_Female, total),
    decimals = 0
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(pct_Male, pct_Female),
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  # bold column labels
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
  ) %>%
  # 3) italic subtitle
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(style = "italic", size = px(16)),
    locations = cells_title(groups = "subtitle")
  ) %>%
  # 3) italic percentages
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(style = "italic"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = c(pct_Male, pct_Female))
  ) %>%
  # bold the "Total" row text
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = subtype == "Total")
  ) %>%
  # 1) double line above the "Total" row
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(
      sides  = "top",
      style  = "double"
    ),
    locations = cells_body(rows = subtype == "Total")
  )

gt_gender_table2

gtsave(gt_gender_table2, "/Users/matildeelene/Desktop/Bachelors/StereoSet-master/plots/gt_gender_table2.png")
```

```{r}
compare_sources_long <- compare_sources %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("prop"),
               names_to = "source",
               values_to = "prop") %>%
  mutate(source = recode(source,
                         "prop_platania" = "Platania",
                         "prop_psykiatrien" = "Psykiatrien"))

ggplot(compare_sources_long, aes(x = subtype, y = prop, fill = source)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    x = "ADHD subtype",
    y = "Proportion",
    title = "Comparison of subtype proportions: Platania vs Psykiatrien"
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)

valid_subtypes <- c("ADHD-I", "ADHD-HI", "ADHD-C")

platania_clean <- platania %>%
  filter(subtype %in% valid_subtypes)

# Long → wide: Male / Female columns
table_data <- platania_clean %>%
  group_by(subtype, gender) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = gender,
    values_from = n
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total = Male + Female,
    prop  = round(total / sum(total) * 100, 2)
  )

table_with_total <- table_data %>%
  bind_rows(
    table_data %>%
      summarise(
        subtype = "Total",
        Male    = sum(Male, na.rm = TRUE),
        Female  = sum(Female, na.rm = TRUE),
        total   = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE),
        prop    = 100  # overall = 100%
      )
  )



gt_table <- table_data %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "ADHD Gender Distributions within Subtypes",
    subtitle = "After data cleaning (n = 147; final n = 2,110)") %>%
  cols_label(
    subtype = "Subtype",
    Male    = "Males (n)",
    Female  = "Females (n)",
    total   = "Total (n)",
    prop    = "Percentage"
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = everything()
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(Male, Female, total),
    decimals = 0
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = prop,
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  # bold column labels
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
  ) %>%
  # bold the "Total" row
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(
      rows = subtype == "Total"
    )
  )

gt_table
```
